name: Boulder Daily Camera editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides lists the Daily Camera as Not Rated, and no Ad Fontes rating was found. Its stated mission is 'To deliver essential, informed and relevant news to our readers' (https://www.dailycamera.com/about-us/). No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters of Boulder County
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter; its site describes the League as 'a nonpartisan, grassroots organization' (https://www.lwvbc.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Boulder Reporting Lab
lean_basis: Nonprofit newsroom (no endorsements) that promises 'Quality, non-partisan reporting that digs beneath the surface on issues of public importance' (https://boulderreportinglab.org/about-us/). No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.
